name: Sayori
source:
Often seen as the sunshine in anyone's day, this cheery, bubbly girl radiates positivity. She was the protagonist's childhood friend and the two were nigh inseparable - that was until high school rolled around. Don't be fooled by her jovial exterior; underneath, things aren't as they seem…

[Edited from the [url=https://blueskiesmod.club/characters.html]official website[/url]]
